_about: Model-side configuration: where runs write, how they are logged, and how training jobs are submitted. Run configs (configs/*.json5) give data_dir, embedding_path and output_dir relative to the directories here. The datasets themselves are the data pipeline's: storage root, dataset registry and token block length are read from data_pipeline.

storage._about: Directories under the data pipeline's storage.root.

wandb._modes: online: log to wandb.ai; offline: log locally for a later `wandb sync` (no network needed); disabled: no logging, wandb not imported

groups._about: The paper's runs. A job trains the config and then scores its best checkpoint on the group's test set(s) (names from the data pipeline's dataset registry), writing <storage.predictions>/<run>__<dataset>.csv.

table1._about: embedding x signature length, trained on all orders

table2._about: training-set size, trained on |G| <= 64, tested on |G| > 64
